introHtml: Long sleeve baby and toddler apparel offers extra coverage for cooler weather or indoor events, making it a practical choice for family-friendly promotions. Whether you're outfitting a company picnic or a hospital welcome kit, these garments provide a soft cotton canvas for screen printing or embroidery. The extended sleeves also allow for larger logo placement on the arms, giving your brand more visibility on a tiny frame.
